title: Summer Internship Program (SIP)

about: The NIH Summer Internship Program (SIP) in the United States runs from 10 May to 31 August 2027. Applications are due 26 January 2027 at 12 pm (noon) ET, and reference letters by 2 February 2027 at 12 pm (noon) ET.
